tools.name: validate_postcode
tools.description: Check whether a postal code has a valid format for a country and return its normalized form (uppercase, official space or hyphen), a format example and the country name. Example: country "NL", code "1234ab" → valid true, normalized "1234 AB". Format check only (Google libaddressinput patterns): it d

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List every supported country and territory with its ISO code, English name, whether it uses postal codes, a format example and the local name for the code (zip, eircode, PIN…). Read-only. Same data as GET /v1/countries.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "validate_postcode" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
